# Wintun (Windows TUN)

RocketBox Tunnel on Windows loads `wintun.dll` from the same directory as
`rocketbox-tunnel.exe`.

- Header: `include/wintun.h` (upstream, GPL-2.0 OR MIT)
- DLL: download at build/CI time via `scripts/fetch-wintun.ps1` from
  https://www.wintun.net/ (do not commit the DLL)

License: see https://www.wintun.net/
